mapper.sql: id, merchant_id, total_gross, total_commission, total_net, entry_count, status, review_note, reviewer_id, gmt_created, gmt_reviewed
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_bill (id, merchant_id, total_gross, total_commission, total_net, entry_count, status, review_note, reviewer_id, gmt_created, gmt_reviewed) VALUES (#{id}, #{merchantId}, #{totalGross}, #{totalCommission}, #{totalNet}, #{entryCount}, #{status}, #{reviewNote}, #{reviewerId}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtReviewed})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM settlement_bill WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY gmt_created DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_net), 0) FROM settlement_bill WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND status = 'PAID'
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_bill SET status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, gmt_reviewed = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
